title: Geometric connectedness is tested on one algebraically closed extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme over $k$, and let $\bar k/k$ be a field extension with $\bar k$ algebraically closed (every nonconstant polynomial in $\bar k[T]$ has a root in $\bar k$). Then $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] (that is, $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] for every field extension $k'/k$) if and only if the base change $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ is connected. In particular a geometrically connected scheme over $k$ is nonempty.

source.place: Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387 (lemma-characterize-geometrically-connected), stated for a separable algebraic closure; the algebraically closed case follows from it and Lemma 33.7.3, tag 054N (lemma-geometrically-connected-check-after-extension)
